{{Top|leg}}
'''Jaro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Harix]]ian who was a friend of [[Berd Lin]]. It was Jaro who showed Lin how to employ [[Target drone/Legends|target drones]] in such a way as to fool the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] into thinking a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was approaching.
